profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
As a staff software engineer at Google and manager of a >20 engineer team, I have experience in developing and leading innovative video & image editing development for the Google Photos app on Android, reaching over a billion monthly users worldwide.

My core competencies include Android development, machine learning algorithms, on-device ML, computer graphics, and data analytics. I am passionate about applying cutting-edge ML techniques on mobile devices to enhance the quality and creativity of digital photography for all!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Software engineering manager leading Gemini-powered editing experiences in Google Workspace.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Software engineer, technical lead, and manager on Google Photos app for Android. Technical lead for computational photography and image editing on Android, building and maintaining ML-powered effects used by millions: Magic Eraser, Photo Unblur, Auto-Enhance with Real Tone, Portrait Light, post-capture portrait blur, sky palette transfer, HDR, any many more. Former technical lead for photo books and wall art projects on Android.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineer on Android Treble and the Vendor Test Suite. Primary developer responsible for native test coverage instrumentation, continuous collection, and monitoring at the hardware abstraction layer (HAL). Owner of the open-sourced VTS Dashboard, a Google App Engine-based continuous integration user interface and notification service for interacting with test results, performance metrics, coverage display with source code overlay.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Implemented the redesigned administrator console web interface for Evernote Business using React and Stripes frameworks. Contributed to API changes for Evernote Business. Developed behavioral-driven unit tests of client-side JavaScript with Mocha, Chai, and Sinon frameworks.

positions.title: Engineering Learning Initiative Tutor
positions.description:
Tutored students in MATH 1920: “Multi-Variable Calculus” and CS 2110: “Object
Oriented Programming and Data Structures”

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted Professor John Hopcroft in teaching CS 4850: “Mathematics for the Information Age” by holding weekly office hours and grading assignments and exams.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed web-based monitoring tools for ion implanters using JavaScript and HTML5. These include animated SVG-based graphs, streaming data tables optimized for large data sets, and responsive SVG Gantt charts. Implemented a WebGL-based rendering engine to view CAD drawings in-browser. Architected and developed the server used for the processing, analysis, and delivery of ion implanter runtime data using C# and ISAPI handlers.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Designed and instrumented test stands for the purpose of investigating plasma flood gun prototypes for use in ion implanters. Control, instrumentation, and data analysis were developed using LabVIEW.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created applications using MATLAB to perform uniformity analysis on silicon wafer scans after ion implantation.

honors.title: Cornell University College of Engineering Dean's List
honors.description: Awarded Dean's List status for eight consecutive semesters: Fall 2012, Spring 2013, Fall 2013, Spring 2014, Fall 2014, Spring 2015,  Fall 2015, and Spring 2016.

honors.title: Certificate of Recognition for Performance in German Studies
honors.description: Three-time recipient of the German book prize recognizing strong academic performance on behalf of the Cornell University Department of German Studies and the Consulate General of the Federal Republic of Germany.
honors.issuer: Issued by Cornell University and the Consulate General of the Federal Republic of Germany · May 2015
